content: SQLite strftime %W is NOT ISO-8601 week numbering: %W counts Mondays from Jan 1 of the calendar year (no Thursday-rule, no year-voting), while %U is Sunday-anchored. Both can disagree with true ISO week (%V, only in newer SQLite builds, needs %G for the ISO week-year or boundaries are ambiguous at year edges). SQLite does not auto-adjust for DST; local-time modifiers can shift bucket boundaries by an hour across DST transitions.
